title: SideStack Social
description: A native Windows 11 app that puts 20+ web apps in one window. Each app gets its own isolated WebView2 profile, so you can stay logged into multiple accounts of the same service. Also has native notifications, per-app camera/mic permissions, and alarms and reminders that still ring when the app is closed. Packaged as an MSIX for the Microsoft Store.

title: SyncViewer
description: A multi-cloud VM monitoring platform with an offline-first React PWA. Runs on a 20-table Postgres schema with row-level security and audit logs, and syncs changes to each browser's IndexedDB cache using version cursors. Includes a Gemini-powered agent you can ask about uptime, plus team workspaces with admin, developer and viewer roles.

title: TabWriter Text Editor
description: A lightweight, distraction-free multi-tab text editor built for Windows 11 using WinUI 3 and C#. Published to the Microsoft Store via MSIX packaging.

title: AI-Powered Discord Assistant
stack: Python, Discord.py, Gemini, Sarvam AI, Azure
description: An asynchronous Python bot built using discord.py. Handles text, voice and speech translation through Google Gemini and Sarvam AI, and uses Azure Text-to-Speech to turn messages and files into audio summaries.
